item.subject: science
item.stem:
Priya looks into three mirrors at a science exhibition in her school in Pune.
In mirror 1, her image is erect and the same size as her face.
In mirror 2, when she stands close, her image is erect and enlarged.
In mirror 3, her image is always erect and smaller than her face, no matter where she stands.
Which row correctly names the three mirrors?

options.A: mirror 1: convex, mirror 2: plane, mirror 3: concave
options.B: mirror 1: plane, mirror 2: concave, mirror 3: convex
options.C: mirror 1: concave, mirror 2: convex, mirror 3: plane
options.D: mirror 1: plane, mirror 2: convex, mirror 3: concave
